'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks on civilians in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Hroza missile attack]]
****[[Ukraine]] says that [[Russia]] has attacked a store and cafe in [[Hroza, Kharkiv Oblast|Hroza]], [[Kharkiv Oblast]], with a [[ballistic missile]], killing at least 51 [[civilian]]s. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-war-zelenskyy-travel-drone-attacks-f7c320ed2908b447f32bf32ede8caf2f (AP)]
***Russia says that a child has been killed and three others are injured while trying to dismantle [[cluster munition]]s fired from Ukrainian forces, in the [[Russian-occupied territories of Ukraine|occupied]] city of [[Horlivka]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/10/5/russia-ukraine-war-live-kyiv-says-24-drones-launched-by-moscow-downed (Al Jazeera)]
**[[List of military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War|Military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War]]
***The [[United States]] transfers 1.1 million rounds of [[Iran]]ian [[ammunition]] to Ukraine after the [[United States Navy|U.S. Navy]] [[Civil forfeiture in the United States|seized]] them from a shipment enroute to [[Yemen]] in December. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-67014218 (BBC News)]
***[[Chancellor of Germany|German Chancellor]] [[Olaf Scholz]] pledges a second [[MIM-104 Patriot|Patriot air defense system]] to Ukraine. [https://www.spiegel.de/politik/ukraine-krieg-scholz-sagt-kiew-lieferung-von-weiterem-patriot-system-zu-a-a7d75ab1-a328-4391-83f5-4eeb9e549be3 (Spiegel)]
**Russia announces the successful test of the [[9M730 Burevestnik|Burevestnik]], a nuclear-powered and nuclear-capable [[cruise missile]] with a potential range of thousands of miles. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/putin-says-russia-has-tested-next-generation-nuclear-weapon-2023-10-05/ (Reuters)]  
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[2023 Homs drone strike]]
***At least 112 troops and civilians are killed and 120 others are injured in a [[Drone warfare|drone attack]] on a [[Syrian Armed Forces|Syrian military]] [[graduation]] ceremony in [[Homs]], [[Syria]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/10/5/syrian-military-college-hit-in-drone-attack (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.syriahr.com/%d8%a7%d8%b1%d8%aa%d9%81%d8%a7%d8%b9-%d8%ad%d8%b5%d9%8a%d9%84%d8%a9-%d8%aa%d9%81%d8%ac%d9%8a%d8%b1-%d8%a7%d9%84%d9%83%d9%84%d9%8a%d8%a9-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%ad%d8%b1%d8%a8%d9%8a%d8%a9-%d9%81%d9%8a-%d8%ad/681946/ (SOHR)]
**[[2023 Turkish drone shootdown]]
***A [[Turkish Air Force]] Anka-S is shot down by an [[Combined Joint Task Force – Operation Inherent Resolve|international coalition]] [[General Dynamics F-16 Fighting Falcon|F-16 Fighting Falcon]] in [[Al-Hasakah Governorate|Al Hasakah]], Syria, after reportedly operating too close to [[United States Armed Forces|U.S. forces]] in the vicinity. [https://www.i24news.tv/en/news/middle-east/levant-turkey/1696529308-alleged-turkish-drone-gets-shot-down-near-u-s-forces-in-syria (Israel 24 News)] [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-drone-shot-turkey-syria-b2424841.html (''The Independent'')]
**[[October 2023 Northern Syria clashes]]
***[[Turkey]] launches a series of [[airstrike]]s targeting the [[Syrian Democratic Forces]] in [[northeastern Syria]], killing at least two people and injuring three others. [https://www.i24news.tv/en/news/middle-east/levant-turkey/1696494319-turkish-airstrikes-in-syria-target-kurdish-areas-killing-2-people (i24 News)]
**At least six people are killed and 38 others are injured during a series of airstrikes by the [[Syrian Air Force]] on [[Idlib]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/10/5/syria-live-news-dozens-killed-in-drone-attack-on-military-college (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**Four [[Palestinians]] are killed in separate incidents in the occupied [[West Bank]], three by [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli soldiers]], and one by an [[Israeli settler]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/10/5/israeli-troops-kill-two-palestinians-in-occupied-west-bank-clash (Al Jazeera)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Jon Fosse]] is awarded the [[Nobel Prize in Literature]] for his innovative plays, prose and style, which has come to be known as Fosse [[minimalism]]. [https://www.cnn.com/style/article/nobel-prize-literature-jon-fosse-intl/index.html (CNN)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Pacific typhoon season]]
**[[Typhoon Koinu]] makes landfall in [[Hengchun]], [[Pingtung County]], [[Taiwan]] as a [[Tropical cyclone scales|category 4]] typhoon, with winds of over 342 kilometers in [[Orchid Island]], becoming the strongest on record. [https://dw.com/en/taiwan-typhoon-koinu-brings-record-winds/a-67000080 (DW)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/oct/06/weather-tracker-typhoon-koinu-disruption-taiwan (''The Guardian'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Abkhazia–Russia relations]]
**[[Russia]] and [[Abkhazia]] sign an agreement to establish a permanent [[naval base]] for the [[Russian Navy]] on the [[Black Sea]] coast of [[Ochamchira District]], [[Abkhazia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-plans-naval-base-black-sea-coast-breakaway-georgian-region-izvestiya-2023-10-05/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Italian authorities]] impound the [[Open Arms (watercraft)|''Open Arms'']] vessel used by Spanish [[Non-governmental organization|NGO]] [[Proactiva Open Arms]] to rescue migrants in the [[Mediterranean Sea]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/italy-impounds-migrant-charity-ship-after-multiple-rescues-2023-10-05/ (Reuters)]
*The [[Netherlands|Dutch]] [[platform supply vessel]] ''VOS Pace'' rescues 79 migrants in the [[Atlantic Ocean]], nine of whom [[mutiny]]. The mutineers are later arrested in [[Fuerteventura]], [[Canary Islands]]. [https://nos.nl/artikel/2492957-migranten-muiten-aan-boord-van-nederlands-schip-na-redding (NOS)] 
*An investigation into electronic surveillance by [[European Investigative Collaborations]] reveals inefficiencies in [[European Union]] regulations governing the sale of enabling software.  [https://www.spiegel.de/international/business/the-predator-files-european-spyware-consortium-supplied-despots-and-dictators-a-2fd8043f-c5c1-4b05-b5a6-e8f8b9949978 (Spiegel)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Immigration policy of the Joe Biden administration]]
**The [[Biden administration]] announces that it will waive 26 [[federal law]]s in [[Starr County]], [[Texas]], in order to allow construction of the [[Mexico–United States border wall|border wall]] in an attempt to help prevent [[illegal immigration to the United States|illegal entry into the country]]. [https://apnews.com/article/border-wall-biden-immigration-texas-rio-grande-147d7ab497e6991e9ea929242f21ceb2 (AP)]
*The [[European Parliament|EU Parliament]] votes 279–173, with 33 [[abstention]]s, in favor of the appointment of [[Wopke Hoekstra]] as the new [[European Commissioner for Climate Action|EU Commissioner]]. [https://www.zeit.de/politik/ausland/2023-10/eu-parlament-klima-kommissar-anleihen-nachhaltigkeit (Zeit)] [https://www.tagesschau.de/ausland/europa/eu-klimakommissar-parlament-100.html (Tagesschau)]
*[[Kenya]]n [[List of Foreign Ministers of Kenya|foreign minister]] [[Alfred Mutua]] is replaced by [[Musalia Mudavadi]] following controversy over the country's involvement in the [[Haitian crisis (2018–present)|crisis in Haiti]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-67014881 (BBC News)]
*The [[Chamber of Representatives (Belgium)]] of [[Belgium]] is the first parliament in the world to adopt a resolution in support of [[Agent Orange]] victims. [https://www.lachambre.be/doc/flwb/pdf/55/2406/55k2406005.pdf (Official website of the Belgian Parliament lachambre.be)]
